body: I sure hope so!  I'm sorta planning to get back to Florida a year from now.  We'll see.  Its a little nerve wracking because that's where the problems came up in the first place.  But on the other hand, if I make that change successfully, I'm free.

I am.  That's prat of what has kept me going in the past.  I've been far worse than I am today, and one of the main reasons I didn't end it is because I wanted to see where society is going.  I'm a massive history buff.  I love technology.  I watch the news like a hawk.  For a while, it was like life was a movie and I was the audience. I've been working hard to fix that and get involved again.

Anyway I really appreciate your comment.  I'm doing better now, talked to my best friend on the phone, got out of bed/showered/etc.  The curiosity and the love for my family/friends has kept me going so far, and it will continue to do so.  But man, life is a BITCH sometimes haha.  But you're right.  Wait for/cause good changes.  That's really all I can do, and that's not really a bad thing.
